Local governments are not required to pay the Olmsted
County transit sales tax (or other local general sales taxes).
No exemption certificate is necessary. But state sales tax
generally applies.

Local governments include cities, towns, counties,
instrumentalities, political subdivisions, commissions,
special districts and government boards.
